title: Deep Sea Fishing Kauai
specs: Children under 15 and active-duty military members are exempt and do not need a license.

services.name: 4 Hour Private Charter
services.desc: BIG CONTACT IS REAL! We are lucky to travel the oceans surface and encounter the biggest and strongest fish on the planet right outside the harbor entrance. You cannot miss this incredible opportunity to experience the best the islands have to offer and experience an incredible fishing adventure aboard our legendary strike boat. Experience game of the finest kind: Blue marlin, Black marlin, Stripped Marlin, Short Nosed Spearfish, Mahi Mahi, Ono, Yellow Fin, Big Eye and Skipjack Tunas. It can and does happen year around! Our strike boat is available for private charters for a single angler or 6:30am or 8am or 1pm Boat-Launch • up to 6 Passengers

blurb: Welcome to DEEP SEA FISHING KAUAI, the original “Ultimate Hawaiian Fishing Adventure.” Kauai is a magnificent fishing destination uniquely suited for the outdoor enthusiast, our remote location and deep waters provide easy access to the world’s most powerful game fish.
